description: This Java class defines a custom Volley request for handling multipart/form-data uploads, including text and binary data parts, for Android network operations.

classes.name: VolleyMultipartRequest.DataPart
classes.description: Nested class representing a data part for file upload, containing filename, content bytes, and optional MIME type.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns request headers, defaulting to superclass headers if none set.

methods.name: getBodyContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type for multipart/form-data with boundary.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Constructs and returns the request body as a byte array, combining text parameters and binary data parts.

methods.name: parseNetworkResponse
methods.description: Parses the network response into a Volley Response object.

methods.name: deliverResponse
methods.description: Delivers the network response to the registered listener.

methods.name: deliverError
methods.description: Delivers an error to the registered error listener.

methods.name: getByteData
methods.description: Method intended to be overridden to provide binary data parts; returns null by default.

methods.name: textParse
methods.description: Serializes text parameters into the data output stream.

methods.name: dataParse
methods.description: Serializes binary data parts into the data output stream.

methods.name: buildTextPart
methods.description: Writes a text field into the multipart request.

methods.name: buildDataPart
methods.description: Writes a file data part into the multipart request.
